notes.title: PDPD is LIVE!
notes.content:
PDPD is now live worldwide!
As noted in the description, our game uses an online high score system to keep track of everyone's scores.
You are able to see any score that has been uploaded from the main menu, if you see any scores that you believe may be fraudulent please let us know and we will look into it immediately.

Enjoy! And as always, please let us know if there are any issues.
